settings.ovnfs.path.label: ovnfs Binary
settings.ovnfs.path.description: ovnfs executable; unset looks for `ovnfs` on PATH. When it is found, ovnfs checkouts (copy-on-write views of a folder, ready in about a second at any size) serve every separate copy: the system prompt tells agents to open checkouts instead of git worktrees or copies, and isolated subagents (when allowed, with `isolation.backend` on auto) run in checkouts instead of native clones
settings.task.autoParallel.label: Auto Parallel
settings.task.autoParallel.description: Ask the native judge resolved through the 'judge' role which parts of each new top-level prompt can run concurrently. Needs a native judge and the task tool; without them nothing is judged.
settings.task.steps.label: Sequential Task Steps
settings.task.steps.description: Spawns take ordered `steps` instead of one `task`: the subagent gets the first step, then each next one once it finishes the previous; past 4 steps, earlier messages carry two or more. The last step's result is the task's result.
settings.task.perCallModel.label: Per-Call Model
settings.task.perCallModel.description: Whether a subagent call may pick its model with one exact provider/model-id[@upstream][:level] selector. An @upstream pin is part of the model identity and is supported only by aggregators. Only models the configuration already routes to are accepted. Project settings can turn it off but not on, and never approve a model.
settings.task.perCallModelAllow.label: Per-Call Model Allowlist
settings.task.perCallModelAllow.descript: Exact selectors: `provider/model-id`, including `@upstream` only for a pinned OpenRouter/Vercel route (e.g. `openrouter/x@y`). When set, a per-call model must also be listed here. Empty: every model the configuration grants. A project list can only narrow this one.
settings.task.workerThreads.label: Subagent Worker Threads
settings.task.workerThreads.description: Maximum worker threads for subagents. Up to 8 concurrent subagents run on the main thread; at 9 one worker joins, and one more each time the count doubles (18, 36, 72). Workers stop a minute after no subagent is live in them; 0 keeps every subagent on the main thread
settings.mnemopi.recallRelevance.label: Mnemopi Recall Relevance
settings.mnemopi.recallRelevance.descrip: Ask the judge model role whether each automatically recalled memory is relevant to the task before injecting it
settings.disassembler.backend.label: Disassembler
settings.disassembler.backend.descriptio: Backend for analysis selectors in read and eval's dsm namespace; bare executable reads show metadata only. Auto uses IDA Pro when installed, else Ghidra (downloaded on first analysis)
settings.disassembler.maxOpen.label: Max Open Databases
settings.disassembler.maxOpen.descriptio: Most databases (omp.ida.* / omp.ghidra.* daemons in omp ps) open at once per project; opening another evicts an unreferenced idle one. Close retained dsm handles when done
settings.disassembler.idleCloseSec.label: Idle Close Timeout
settings.disassembler.idleCloseSec.descr: Save and close unreferenced databases idle longer than this many seconds (0 = never); retained dsm handles stay open. The exec namespace resets on reopen
settings.ghidra.installDir.label: Ghidra Install Dir
settings.ghidra.installDir.description: Ghidra 12+ install directory (contains Ghidra/application.properties); empty uses $GHIDRA_INSTALL_DIR, Homebrew, else a managed download under ~/.omp/ghidra
settings.ghidra.python.label: Ghidra Python
settings.ghidra.python.description: Python interpreter that can import pyghidra; empty uses a managed venv built from the install's bundled wheels
settings.hindsight.globalScope.label: Hindsight Global Scope
settings.hindsight.globalScope.descripti: Let retain and learn take scope: global, which stores a memory without the project tag so every project recalls it. Needs global or per-project-tagged scoping
settings.bash.allowedEnvVars.label: Bash Allowed Environment Variables
settings.bash.allowedEnvVars.description: Exact environment variable names allowed as leading KEY=VALUE prefixes when matching bash.patterns allow rules (no wildcards). Any value is accepted, so list only benign build/test variables; execution-altering variables (PATH, LD_PRELOAD, BASH_ENV, *_RUNNER, *_WRAPPER) allow arbitrary command execution.
settings.auth.unpausedProviders.label: Unpaused Providers
settings.auth.unpausedProviders.descript: Turn providers we paused back on: login, token refresh and stored credentials work again. Each pause names the account risk you accept. Project settings cannot set this
settings.tools.restrictedFolders.label: Restricted Folders
settings.todo.midRunNudges.label: Mid-Run Todo Nudges
settings.todo.midRunNudges.description: How often a long turn is reminded to update its todo list while it keeps changing things
settings.find.verifyModel.label: Find Verification Model
settings.find.verifyModel.description: Model selector (e.g. openrouter/liquid/d1-ultra) tried first for find's passage verification, before the judge role; filename and sketch ranking stay on the judge role. Unset: the judge role verifies too
settings.commit.enabled.label: Selective commit
settings.commit.enabled.description: Enable the commit eval prelude and /commit: commit only the lines this agent and its subagents wrote
settings.out.enabled.label: Out
settings.out.enabled.description: Let the agent reply mid-task by writing to out://, shown like a response without ending its turn. Unset: on in the interactive TUI, off in print, RPC, and ACP
settings.async.printWake.label: Wake Print Mode on Job Results
settings.async.printWake.description: In print mode (-p, --mode json), keep running after the last prompt while this run's background jobs are active, and start another turn in the same session with each job's result; exits once no job or result is pending. Off: print mode exits after its prompts and cancels running jobs
settings.tools.xdevNotices.label: xd:// Mount Notices
settings.tools.xdevNotices.description: Show an `xd://: mounted …` notice when MCP or extension tools are mounted or unmounted. The model still learns of the change with its next prompt.
settings.browser.webkit.label: WebKit Browser
settings.browser.webkitPath.label: Browser WebKit Path
settings.browser.webkitPath.description: omp's WebKit engine: its host executable, or an ABKit engine directory (which holds it as ABHost; ABHost.exe on Windows). If unset, omp runs the installed engine, ~/.o2/lib/abkit/ABHost (ABHost.exe on Windows). Supports ~. PI_BROWSER_WEBKIT_PATH overrides it.
settings.statusLine.leftSegments.label: status line segment
settings.statusLine.rightSegments.label: status line segment
settings.tui.maxInlineImageColumns.descr: Maximum width in terminal columns for inline images (default 100). Set to 0 for unlimited (bounded only by terminal width).
settings.tui.maxInlineImageRows.descript: Maximum height in terminal rows for inline images (default 20). Set to 0 to use only the viewport-based limit (60% of terminal height).
settings.tui.maxInlineImages.description: Maximum number of inline images kept as live terminal graphics (default 8). Older images fall back to a text placeholder via a full redraw once the limit is exceeded. Set to 0 to keep every image (no limit).
settings.tui.colorfulMarkdown.label: Colorful Markdown
settings.tui.colorfulMarkdown.descriptio: Color headings by level, bold and italic text, inline code, and table headers from the theme's ANSI palette. Off uses one heading color and plain bold/italic.
settings.tui.renderEmbeds.label: Render Embedded Images and Pages
settings.tui.renderEmbeds.description: Invite the agent to show pictures with and web pages with
settings.tui.spinnerInterval.label: Spinner Interval (ms)
settings.tui.spinnerInterval.description: Milliseconds between frames of every spinner, the terminal title included; 0 shows static glyphs. Unset follows Motion
settings.tui.maxFps.label: Max Frames Per Second
settings.tui.maxFps.description: Ceiling on how often the TUI repaints, streaming text included. Keystroke echo keeps 30 fps, so the pane you type in stays responsive
settings.tui.motion.label: Motion
settings.tui.motion.description: One switch over spinners, shimmer, and decorative blink/fade. Streaming text is unaffected (see Max Frames Per Second). A spinner interval you set still wins
settings.display.shellVisualization.desc: Show bash commands as an interactive execution visualization instead of plain shell commands
settings.display.advisorCollapsedLines.d: Maximum note lines a collapsed advisor card shows below its header (0 keeps the full preview; expand with the tool-output toggle)
settings.btw.inject.label: /btw Steering Inject
settings.btw.inject.description: When you ask /btw for a steering prompt, it drafts one in <inject> tags, highlighted in the answer; Alt+I (app.btw.inject) sends it to the main session
settings.update.auto.label: Auto Update
settings.update.auto.description: Install omp updates in the background on startup; the next launch runs the new version
settings.title.refreshAfterPrompts.label: Refresh Title After Prompts
settings.title.refreshAfterPrompts.descr: Every this many operator prompts, ask the judge model whether a generated session title still fits the conversation, and regenerate it if not
settings.spotlight.experiment.enabled.de: Shape tool output and rank find results with Stencil Spotlight, and log each shaped result to the session
settings.session.worktreeScope.label: Resume Worktree Scope
settings.session.worktreeScope.descripti: Choose whether the resume picker's current folder includes sessions from other repository worktrees
settings.prewalk.from.label: Prewalk planning model
settings.prewalk.from.description: Model or role (default '@default') that /prewalk restart returns to for planning.
settings.prewalk.into.label: Prewalk target
settings.prewalk.into.description: Model or role (default '@smol') that prewalk hands off to at the first edit/write: /prewalk, /prewalk restart, Enable Prewalk, and --prewalk. Auto-prewalk uses its own target.
settings.extensionHandlers.modeControl.d: Let extensions enter and exit plan, vibe, goal, and loop modes via ctx.sessionModes.set(); reading mode state stays available
settings.extensionRenderers.assistantTex: Let extensions change how assistant replies are drawn, redraw a reply in place, and receive clicks on their own links; the session, exports and model context keep the reply as written
settings.extensionRenderers.transcriptPr: Let extensions draw transcript blocks such as tool calls in full, as one compact row, or hidden; the session, exports and model context are unchanged
settings.live.endpoint.label: Live Endpoint
settings.live.endpoint.description: Base URL of an OpenAI Realtime WebRTC-compatible server (e.g. http://127.0.0.1:8080/v1) used for live voice instead of Codex; empty uses Codex
settings.live.apiKey.label: Live Endpoint API Key
settings.live.apiKey.description: Bearer key sent only to the live endpoint: a literal, an environment variable name, or !command
